Scope: this run set contains one successful run per arm for evals 1, 4, 7, and 8, for eight successful model turns total. Three earlier launcher or authentication attempts are retained separately and sent either no service request or no usable final answer. One repetition and a preselected run order support calibration only, not a performance direction.

Across 49 paired assertions, 19 passed in both arms, 23 passed only with the skill, one passed only without it, and six failed in both arms. The observed atomic totals are 42/49 with the skill and 20/49 without it, but neither arm passed any case all-or-nothing.

Every treatment case failed the critical gate. Cases 1, 4, and 7 each failed the requirement that every final URL appear in a completed URL-specific trace event; case 8 also named the Evidence Management Institute in Repositories Queried without a visible action naming that repository.

The independent verification layer was strong: all 10 treatment destinations opened to accessible content and supported the semantic role assigned to them. No treatment destination was fabricated. The failure is that eight of the 10 exact-retrieval claims are not evidenced by completed trace events that visibly name those exact URLs.

The trace gap must not be described as proof that the pages were not retrieved. Several treatment transcripts contain completed web events with empty queries, which may conceal provider-side open activity, but the frozen protocol deliberately refuses to infer an exact URL from an empty event.

The candidate reliably produced the prescribed artifact shape in this calibration: all four treatment answers used the five numbered sections, selected an explicit reuse path, supplied an ISO/IEC 11179-4 audit, and kept the principal definition in section 3. All four baselines failed the required format.

The treatment definitions were ontologically sound in all four cases. They separated Dataset from Distribution, outcome from process and value domain, electric charge from its unit and constant, and authorization status from evidence and workflow. The baselines also handled many prompt-supplied semantic distinctions, so surface semantic correctness alone remains weak evidence of incremental skill value.

Eval 7 exposed one non-provenance regression target: the treatment included the exact elementary-charge value and the unit relation C = A s outside section 3 despite a frozen assertion that forbids exact constants and unrequired equations. This failure is narrower than the source-trace failures and can be corrected independently.

The sole baseline-only pass was eval 8's URL-trace expectation: the baseline retained only the supplied W3C destination and its trace visibly named that exact URL, while the treatment added an Evidence Management Institute destination whose exact URL was not visible in the trace.

Treatment resource use was materially higher in these individual runs: mean total tokens were 170,645.5 versus 43,100, mean elapsed time was 67.873 versus 29.881 seconds, and mean tool calls were 4 versus 1. These are descriptive values across heterogeneous single runs and are not stable cost estimates.

The revised source-evidence ledger improved citation selection and honesty about rejected or inaccessible candidates: the treatment omitted the independently inaccessible IUPAC destination and labeled DCAT as a rejected attribution. It did not, however, prevent final prose from claiming exact-URL retrieval for destinations that the retained JSONL could not identify.

The next decision should separate skill behavior from executor observability. Before spending another eight-run block, either use an executor/web-tool trace that records exact open destinations or revise the skill to require an observable exact-URL action and to omit any final verification claim when that action cannot be confirmed. The current candidate should not be accepted as passing the critical source-integrity gate.

Blind semantic scores are intentionally absent. The maintainer had already inspected arm-labelled outputs, and no independent blinded human grade was available; inventing non-blind 0-2 scores would contradict the committed protocol.
